# `fluxsim accuracy`

Seal a prediction before its horizon, score it against an observed readout afterwards, and publish the outcomes-only accuracy record.

## Commands

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`fluxsim accuracy register`](#fluxsim-accuracy-register) | seal a prediction before its horizon |
| [`fluxsim accuracy score`](#fluxsim-accuracy-score) | score a registered prediction against a readout |
| [`fluxsim accuracy record`](#fluxsim-accuracy-record) | publish one registration's outcomes-only record |

## `fluxsim accuracy register`

Seal a PredictionRecord so it cannot be edited after the outcome is known.

### Synopsis

```text
fluxsim accuracy register [options]
```

### Examples

```bash
# seal a prediction
fluxsim accuracy register --file prediction.json
```

### Options

| Option | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--file` | `FILE` | a PredictionRecord as JSON -- fields: prediction_id (string), run_digest (string), metric_id (string), statement (string), predicted (decimal), horizon_end (string), registered_at (string), interval_low (decimal) [optional], interval_high (decimal) [optional] **(required)** |
| `--state-dir` | `STATE_DIR` | run-state directory (default: ./.flux) |
| `-j, --json` |  | emit machine-readable JSON |

## `fluxsim accuracy score`

Bind an ObservedReadout to a sealed prediction and record the verdict.

### Synopsis

```text
fluxsim accuracy score [options]
```

### Examples

```bash
# score it once the outcome is known
fluxsim accuracy score --prediction-id p-1 --readout readout.json
```

### Options

| Option | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--prediction-id` | `PREDICTION_ID` | the id the prediction was registered under **(required)** |
| `--readout` | `READOUT` | an ObservedReadout as JSON -- fields: prediction_id (string), metric_id (string), observed (decimal), sample_size (integer), basis (live-ab\|historical-holdout\|none), observed_at (string) **(required)** |
| `--state-dir` | `STATE_DIR` | run-state directory (default: ./.flux) |
| `-j, --json` |  | emit machine-readable JSON |

## `fluxsim accuracy record`

Publish the outcomes-only accuracy record for everything registered at one registration timestamp.

### Synopsis

```text
fluxsim accuracy record [options]
```

### Examples

```bash
# publish the outcomes-only record
fluxsim accuracy record --registered-at 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z --out accuracy.json
```

### Options

| Option | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--registered-at` | `REGISTERED_AT` | the registration timestamp to publish, as RFC 3339; only the predictions whose registered_at is exactly this are covered **(required)** |
| `--out` | `OUT` | path the accuracy record is written to **(required)** |
| `--state-dir` | `STATE_DIR` | run-state directory (default: ./.flux) |
| `-j, --json` |  | emit machine-readable JSON |
